newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Bondes rates fall at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Bondes rates fall at auction.

text.p: The rate on the Mexican government's 364-day development bonds, or Bondes, fell 0.22 percentage points to 1.12 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate, at an assigned price of 98.99020 pesos, dealers said.

There were 500 million 364-day pesos assigned by Banco de Mexico compared to 4.085 billion pesos worth demanded, way up from demand of 1.825 billion pesos two weeks ago. The rate on 728-day Bondes fell 0.17 percentage points to 1.25 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate, dealers estimated.
The 728-day Bondes were assigned at 97.95565 pesos.
Demand for the two-year Bondes was 4.440 billion pesos, compared to the 700 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
